plain_text:
Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Agnes Moorehead is credited on 56 distinct recordings across 6 programs from 1937-09-26 through 1974-01-26. Documented roles include performer on 56 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are The Shadow (performer on 36 recordings; 36 distinct recordings), Columbia Workshop (performer on 8 recordings; 8 distinct recordings), Suspense (performer on 5 recordings; 5 distinct recordings), Inner Sanctum Mysteries (performer on 3 recordings; 3 distinct recordings), The Mercury Theatre on the Air (performer on 3 recordings; 3 distinct recordings), and CBS Radio Mystery Theater (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording).

Documented character portrayals include Margo Lane (33 portrayals).
